style: Original, clearly illustrated editorial scenes for a Hong Kong family-support brand. Warm, refined hand-painted gouache with delicate watercolour washes and subtle matte paper grain; layered shape, restrained brushwork, gentle dimensional shading and natural human proportions. Richer and more tactile than flat SVG, while remaining calm, contemporary and legible at presentation size. Use paper #FAF7EF as the dominant light ground, sage #DDE8DB and teal #287568 for balanced middle tones, ink #203E3A for structure and hair, amber #D99A3D for a small guiding light or warm accent, and coral #C86D52 for restrained accents and warm terracotta skin tones. Derive lighter and darker painted mixtures from this palette; do not introduce a competing dominant colour. Depict ordinary Hong Kong family life and believable compact homes, with attentive adult caregivers and age-appropriate children. All people are invented illustrated characters, never portraits of real families. Horizontal, reusable compositions with quiet breathing room and no text, logos, QR codes, watermarks, product interfaces, medical imagery, medicines, robots, neon cyberpunk, tourist landmarks or luxury lifestyle staging. Each asset prompt below is complete and may be sent independently to the built-in image generator.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: reusable brand hero for a family-support website, presentation cover and editorial banner.
Primary request: create one original, full-bleed 16:9 horizontal editorial illustration about a reassuring harbour, everyday companionship and a little guidance towards the next step. Show exactly one attentive adult caregiver and one child around seven years old walking hand in hand along an ordinary Hong Kong neighbourhood waterfront. Their relaxed interaction, rather than a city landmark, is the emotional centre. The adult looks towards the child; the child notices a small warm patch of morning light ahead.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet everyday promenade, a broad sheltered curve of water, a few understated residential forms and soft foliage. Suggest a lived-in local neighbourhood with very few details; no sightseeing spectacle. Let the shoreline and foliage make a loose embracing arc around the pair without becoming a literal logo.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape. Place the pair and the main illustrated scene within the right 55 to 60 percent. Preserve the left 35 to 40 percent as calm paper-coloured negative space with only an extremely faint wash, suitable for separate text added later. Keep complete heads, hands and feet comfortably inside the frame.
Style/medium: sophisticated hand-painted editorial gouache, delicate watercolour layering, subtle matte paper grain, confident rounded shapes and gentle dimensional shading. Natural human proportions and clear, anatomically coherent hands; expressive but restrained, neither photorealistic nor a preschool cartoon.
Lighting/mood: soft early daylight, quiet confidence, warmth and possibility; one restrained amber highlight leads the eye forward.
Color palette: paper #FAF7EF dominant; sage #DDE8DB, teal #287568 and ink #203E3A structure the image; amber #D99A3D supplies the guiding light and coral #C86D52 supplies small accents and warm terracotta skin tones. Use harmonious lighter and darker painted mixtures, with no competing dominant colours.
Constraints: the family is entirely fictional and visibly illustrated. This is a conceptual brand scene, not a real family photograph or an operating product demonstration. No text of any kind, letters, numerals, pseudo-writing, logos, QR codes, watermarks or signs. No identifiable tourist landmarks, luggage, luxury advertising, neon cyberpunk, medical symbols, medicines, clinical equipment, robots, holograms or product UI. Show human companionship; technology must not replace adult care. Deliver one cohesive illustration, not a collage, storyboard or set of variants.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: reusable editorial illustration for an everyday-recording concept, family article or presentation section.
Primary request: create one original 3:2 horizontal illustration of a parent noticing a small everyday moment with a toddler and briefly capturing an observation without interrupting their shared activity. Show exactly one adult caregiver seated on a floor mat beside a child around two to three years old who is arranging a few large wooden blocks. The adult is within easy reach, smiling towards the child with attentive eye contact. One relaxed hand holds a small unbranded phone low beside the adult's knee, its screen turned completely away from the viewer; the other hand rests naturally near the blocks. The phone is incidental, not the centre of attention.
Scene/backdrop: a believable compact Hong Kong living room with a low shelf, a small sofa edge and a softly lit window. Keep the home modest, cared for and comfortably lived in, with a few useful objects rather than showroom styling or clutter.
Composition/framing: 3:2 landscape at the seated figures' eye level, using a gentle three-quarter view. The adult, toddler and blocks form a clear, intimate triangular grouping across the middle. Keep some quiet light wall space above and to one side for flexible future cropping. Show complete, coherent hands and age-appropriate body proportions.
Style/medium: refined hand-painted editorial gouache with delicate watercolour washes, fine matte paper texture, layered rounded shapes and soft dimensional shading. Warm and tactile, richer than flat vector art, but not photorealistic, glossy 3D or a baby-product cartoon.
Lighting/mood: diffuse late-morning window light, ease, affection and a sense that recording takes only a small moment within real caregiving.
Color palette: paper #FAF7EF dominant, with sage #DDE8DB and teal #287568 furnishings, ink #203E3A structure and hair, small amber #D99A3D light accents and coral #C86D52 accents and warm terracotta skin tones. Use restrained lighter and darker mixtures of these colours.
Constraints: original invented illustrated people, not a real family or a functioning product demonstration. The phone must show no visible screen content, interface, icons or readable details. No text anywhere, including letters, numerals, pseudo-writing, book spines, packaging or wall signs; no logos, QR codes or watermarks. No medical imagery, medicines, clinical equipment, robots, floating AI characters, surveillance devices, neon cyberpunk, tourism imagery or luxury interiors. The adult remains engaged and responsible for the child. Deliver one cohesive scene, not a sequence or set of variants.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: reusable editorial illustration for caregiver handover, shared family understanding and continuity of care.
Primary request: create one original 3:2 horizontal illustration of two adult caregivers calmly exchanging useful context at home while a school-age child prepares for the next part of the day. Show exactly two adults, one around their thirties and one around their fifties, in ordinary comfortable clothing. Both are equally engaged and have equal visual importance. One gently passes a plain closed notebook across a small table while the other receives it and listens; their body language is reciprocal and respectful. A child around seven or eight sits nearby placing a picture book into an unbranded canvas schoolbag.
Scene/backdrop: the dining corner of a compact Hong Kong flat, with a narrow table, simple chairs, a small storage cabinet and soft daylight from a nearby window. A restrained domestic setting with enough room for believable movement. Avoid institutional, workplace or classroom cues.
Composition/framing: 3:2 landscape, medium-wide three-quarter view. Keep the two adults at the same eye level on either side of the notebook, with the child comfortably included in the lower middle or adjacent foreground. The notebook is a subtle visual bridge, not an oversized symbol. Keep faces, hands and the child's full activity unobstructed, with quiet wall space for adaptable cropping.
Style/medium: warm, sophisticated editorial gouache with subtle watercolour layering and matte paper grain. Use natural proportions, clear hands, gently modelled rounded shapes and restrained facial expressions. Rich tactile illustration, not photography, shiny 3D or a preschool cartoon.
Lighting/mood: balanced afternoon light, mutual trust, shared responsibility and calm continuity; no hierarchy, urgency or exaggerated gratitude.
Color palette: paper #FAF7EF as the main light ground; sage #DDE8DB and teal #287568 in the room and clothing; ink #203E3A for structure and hair; amber #D99A3D and coral #C86D52 for small warm accents and terracotta skin tones. Use only harmonious lighter and darker mixtures around this palette.
Constraints: all people are fictional illustrated characters. Do not depict a real family, an actual service or a product interface. No uniforms, servant-employer staging, authority imbalance, medical staff or clinical objects. Keep the notebook cover and schoolbag unmarked. No text, letters, numerals, pseudo-writing, logos, QR codes or watermarks anywhere. No medicines, medical symbols, robots, holograms, neon cyberpunk, tourist landmarks or luxury lifestyle styling. Human caregivers retain responsibility; no technology substitutes for care. Deliver one cohesive illustration, not panels or variants.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: reusable editorial banner about everyday after-school life for families with children aged six to ten.
Primary request: create one original 16:9 horizontal illustration of an eight- or nine-year-old child settling into an ordinary after-school routine at home with an attentive adult nearby. The child sits at a small dining table drawing a simple leaf or remembered outdoor shape in a blank sketchbook and enthusiastically explains it. The adult sits beside the child at the same level, listening with a relaxed expression and a small natural gesture. Show exactly one child and one adult. A plain schoolbag rests by the chair and a glass of water sits safely on the table, away from the drawing. Convey a balanced transition into home life, not a test, achievement display or intensive tutoring session.
Scene/backdrop: a compact Hong Kong home where the dining area doubles as a quiet activity space. Include a slim bookshelf and a window with muted residential shapes outside. Keep objects few, unbranded and believable; avoid a large luxury study or a generic classroom.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape, relaxed medium-wide side-three-quarter view. Arrange the table and figures across the lower central two-thirds, leaving calm upper-right wall space and a little breathing room around them. The child's face and gesture should be clearly visible; keep hands and the sketchbook anatomically and spatially coherent.
Style/medium: polished editorial gouache, soft watercolour undertones, gentle layered shadows and subtle matte paper grain. Natural age-appropriate proportions, softly rounded forms and thoughtful detail. Clearly painted and richer than flat SVG, without photorealism, glossy 3D or infantile cartoon styling.
Lighting/mood: soft late-afternoon light, an unhurried rhythm and the warmth of being heard. A restrained amber sunlit area can quietly guide the eye towards the shared activity.
Color palette: paper #FAF7EF, sage #DDE8DB, teal #287568, ink #203E3A, amber #D99A3D and coral #C86D52. Keep paper and sage dominant, use teal and ink for structure, and limit amber and coral to warm light, details and terracotta skin tones; use harmonious painted mixtures.
Constraints: an invented illustrated family, not a real photograph or a live product demonstration. The sketchbook contains only a simple wordless drawing. No text, handwriting, pseudo-writing, letters, numerals, school names, logos, QR codes or watermarks anywhere. No grades, charts of achievement, device interfaces, medical imagery, medicines, clinical equipment, robots, neon cyberpunk, tourism landmarks or luxury advertising. Adult companionship is visible and active. Deliver a single cohesive scene, not a storyboard or multiple variants.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: reusable editorial illustration for preparing notes and questions before an upcoming visit or appointment.
Primary request: create one original 3:2 horizontal illustration of a caregiver and a child calmly preparing together at home. Show exactly one adult and one child around six or seven years old at a small table. A plain notebook, three unmarked paper cards and a pencil are arranged in a clear, practical sequence. The adult holds one card and listens as the child contributes a thought with a small natural hand gesture. Convey remembering everyday observations and deciding what to ask, without depicting answers, diagnosis, results or any professional consultation.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet corner of a compact Hong Kong flat with a shallow shelf, a simple chair and diffused light through a domestic window. A small unbranded fabric bag waits beside the table. Keep the setting entirely domestic and modest; there must be no clinic, examination room or medical visual language.
Composition/framing: 3:2 landscape, a slightly elevated three-quarter view that clearly includes both faces, their relaxed interaction and the small arrangement of paper on the table. Use a calm balanced composition with uncluttered background space. Hands and paper must be separate and anatomically coherent; keep every important object within the frame.
Style/medium: refined hand-painted editorial gouache with delicate watercolour washes and subtle matte paper texture. Build warmth through layered rounded shapes, restrained brushwork and soft dimensional shading. Natural proportions, gentle expressions and enough detail for a mature family audience; not photorealistic, glossy 3D or childish cartoon art.
Lighting/mood: soft neutral daylight, thoughtfulness, preparation and confidence, with a tiny amber accent in the light or a household object.
Color palette: paper #FAF7EF dominant, sage #DDE8DB and teal #287568 middle tones, ink #203E3A for structure and hair, amber #D99A3D accents and coral #C86D52 accents and warm terracotta skin tones. Keep all painted mixtures harmonious with these six colours.
Constraints: clearly fictional illustrated people and conceptual preparation, not a real family, real records, a working product or medical advice. The cards and notebook pages must remain genuinely unmarked; no writing, fake handwriting, letter-like marks, letters, numerals, text, logos, QR codes or watermarks anywhere. No diagnosis, medicine, pill containers, syringes, thermometers, stethoscopes, medical crosses, hospital uniforms or other clinical equipment. No screens, robot helpers, floating UI, neon cyberpunk, tourist landmarks or luxury interiors. The adult remains the responsible caregiver and the child is included respectfully. Deliver one cohesive scene, not a sequence or variant sheet.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: reusable editorial banner for quiet evening routines and shared reading with children aged zero to three.
Primary request: create one original 16:9 horizontal illustration of an attentive adult reading a wordless picture book with a toddler around eighteen to twenty-four months old. Show exactly one adult and one toddler, awake and comfortably settled together on a low sofa. The child sits securely against the adult or on the adult's lap; one adult arm provides clear gentle support while the other holds the open book. Their attention is shared between each other and the pictures. The visible pages contain only a few simple painted animal or leaf shapes, with absolutely no writing.
Scene/backdrop: a small, believable Hong Kong living room in the early evening. Include a plain cushion, a low shelf and a warm shaded electric table lamp placed out of the child's reach. A modest window shows a muted deep-teal evening outside without neon signs or a landmark skyline. Keep the home comfortable and lived in, not a nursery showroom.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, intimate medium-wide view. Place the pair slightly right of centre, with the book as a gentle focal point and some quiet paper-and-sage wall space to the left for flexible reuse. Preserve complete heads, clear hands and the visible adult support; use generous breathing room rather than tightly cropping bodies.
Style/medium: sophisticated, tactile editorial gouache with thin watercolour layering and delicate matte paper grain. Soft rounded shapes, natural adult and toddler proportions, subtle facial expression and restrained dimensional shading. Richly painted yet calm; not a photograph, glossy 3D render or exaggerated baby-brand cartoon.
Lighting/mood: low, warm domestic lamplight balanced by a soft teal evening wash, peaceful and attentive rather than sleepy isolation or magical technology. Let the amber lamp create the small guiding warmth in this scene.
Color palette: paper #FAF7EF and sage #DDE8DB for the room; teal #287568 and ink #203E3A for structure, hair and the evening window; amber #D99A3D for lamp light; coral #C86D52 for restrained details and warm terracotta skin tones. Use gentle lighter and darker painted mixtures, without competing saturated colours.
Constraints: all people are fictional illustrated characters, never a real family portrait or an operating product demonstration. Human adult care must be unmistakably present; no unattended child and no technology supervising, soothing or replacing the caregiver. No phones, screens, AI mascots, robots, holograms, candles, medical imagery, medicines or clinical equipment. No text, letters, numerals, pseudo-writing, logos, QR codes or watermarks anywhere, including the book and furnishings. No tourism imagery, luxury advertising or neon cyberpunk. Deliver one cohesive scene, not panels or variants.
